newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CSEMEGE MEINL SEES H1 SALES UP.
newsitem.headline: CSEMEGE MEINL SEES H1 SALES UP.

text.p: Hungarian food retailer Csemege-Julius Meinl Rt said on Thursday it expected preliminary net sales of 25.3 billion forints for the first half of 1997, up 29 percent on the same period of 1996.

The company anticipates a 46 percent increase in operating profit to 583.5 million forints, while its pre-tax profit is seen declining nine percent to 392.5 million forints, the company said in the official bourse gazette.

Julius Meinl released the information in response to reports in the daily Napi Gazdasag on Wednesday saying the group's sales in January-June could reach 27 billion forints while its profits might approach 820 million forints.
